_comment: The NEWS section on the launcher's landing page. Newest first; the
launcher shows at most 4. Edit this file and every launcher shows the
change next time the lobby opens — no release needed. An empty list

news.title: Join a server hosted elsewhere
news.text: The Join tab can now sign in to a multiworld somebody else is running: type the address and your slot name, and London asks the server which game the slot plays and sets it up — including asking for the seed's patch file when one is needed.

news.title: The community, in the launcher
news.text: Two new pages in the top bar: Streamers, with channels that run Archipelago sessions in several languages, and Discord, with community servers whose member counts are read live when the page opens.

news.title: How a multiworld works
news.text: The Multiworld tab grew a guide that explains the whole idea from zero: what a seed is, how to build and host one, and the four things you can do with it — including randomising several of your own games into one run.
